downloadDisclaimer: Souschef is free to download and use.
downloadDisclaimerSubscription: All cooking tools are free. Free accounts include 3 recipe imports per week.
heroAlt: Souschef app — save recipes from Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, and more
header: Import recipes from Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, ChatGPT, Claude, and websites—then organize, shop, and cook step by step.

importGuide.description: Start with a link, photo, pasted text, or an AI-generated idea. Souschef turns it into a clean recipe you can edit, organize, shop from, and cook.

browse.description: Paste a recipe URL from a website, blog, or social post.
browse.guide: Choose Browse or paste the link in the URL field, then import it directly.
browse.title: Browse

chatgpt.description: Ask ChatGPT for a recipe, meal plan, or idea based on what you already have.
chatgpt.guide: Copy ChatGPT's answer, open Text import, paste it in, and save the cleaned-up recipe.
chatgpt.title: ChatGPT

claude.description: Use Claude to turn pantry notes, dietary needs, or leftovers into a usable recipe.
claude.guide: Copy Claude's recipe text, select Text import in Souschef, paste it, and import.
claude.title: Claude

create.description: Build a recipe from scratch when it lives mostly in your head.
create.guide: Choose Create, add the title, ingredients, and steps, then adjust anytime.
create.title: Create

scan.description: Import from cookbooks, handwritten notes, recipe cards, or screenshots.
scan.guide: Choose Scan, take or upload a clear photo, then review the extracted recipe.
scan.title: Scan

text.description: Paste recipe text copied from another app, note, message, or document.
text.guide: Choose Text, paste the full recipe, and let Souschef structure the ingredients and steps.
text.title: Text

importGuide.promptDescription: Ask your AI assistant for something specific, then copy and paste the recipe into Souschef.

promptIdeas.diet: "Make a high-protein vegetarian dinner for two that uses chickpeas and spinach."
promptIdeas.expiring: "I have eggs, tomatoes, and carrots expiring soon. Make a quick recipe using these and keep extra ingredients minimal."
promptIdeas.minimal: "Create a weeknight dinner from chicken thighs, rice, and broccoli with no more than five additional ingredients."

importGuide.promptTitle: What to ask ChatGPT or Claude
importGuide.title: Bring recipes in from anywhere
